t: This is Hibbert Gate, a gate at the West India Docks on the Isle of Dogs. It commemorates George Hibbert, a merchant, politician and ship-owner. With Robert Milligan, he was one of the principals of the West India Dock Company, which brought about the building of the docks in 1800. Both men were slave traders, and Hibbert was a slave owner. He was also an amateur botanist and book collector, and he helped found the Royal National Lifeboat Institution in 1824. The gate carries a name with a complicated legacy.
